name: Escort
source:
In Tokyo, a young seal, Ashiko, works in a dark boring office. He will realize that a huge naked wolf is working there, but as an escort.

The poor canine keeps being humiliated and hurt, right in front of everyone. Determined, Ashiko will try his best to talk to the wolf, hoping to save him, and maybe making him his friend.

[From [url=https://wackywoof.itch.io/escort]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在东京，一只年轻的海豹足子在一间昏暗、无聊的办公室里工作。他会意识到一头巨大的裸狼正在那里工作，但只是作为护卫。

这只可怜的狗在所有人面前不断受到羞辱和伤害。足子决心尽一切努力与狼交谈，希望能拯救他，也许还能让他成为朋友。

[来自[url=https://wackywoof.itch.io/escort]Itch.io[/url]]
